title: Senior Data Scientist, People Analytics & Research
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:
People Analytics & Research is a strong team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Analysts. Our work is highly sought-after, and impacts stakeholders in our People function, and across the business. In this role, you'll take on some of the hardest questions about Airbnb 's workforce - how we recruit, pay, develop, and retain our people - partnering with leaders across Recruiting, Compensation, Talent, and the wider business to turn rigorous analysis into decisions they act on.
The Difference You Will Make:
The People Analytics & Research team is looking for an experienced Data Scientist to lead and/or contribute to our most important research - applying causal inference and quasi-experimental methods to high-stakes people questions: how we recruit, hire, promote, and retain a best-in-class workforce; how we keep key company processes fair; and how work itself is changing. Employee listening and survey analysis are part of the mix, but the heart of the role is rigorous inferential research on observational people data. The role is highly cross-functional, and you will partner with Recruiting, Talent Leaders, Compensation, Legal, and Diversity & Belonging. We need a Data Scientist with a proven track record of translating data into insight and action.
If you have a proven background in this field and are excited to help build Airbnb ’s community, we want to hear from you.
A Typical Day:

• Collaborate with partners and stakeholders to understand people-related business problems, and gather relevant people data to analyze

• Utilize appropriate statistical models and data science methodologies to gain insights, explain, or predict a wide variety of people-related processes, such as recruiting and hiring, promotion, retention, pay equity, productivity, and organizational effectiveness, among others

• Translate data and insights into meaningful visualizations and stories to drive strategy, action, and decision-making with leaders across the business

• Align research priorities with business priorities and take a customer-focused mindset in working with stakeholders

• Lead the team's compensation analytics - the recurring, legally sensitive analyses that inform Total Rewards decisions on pay, compensation structure, and talent awards - in close partnership with Employment Legal and Total Rewards

• Lead design and measurement of Airbnb 's quality-of-hire metric with Recruiting, and own sensitive statutory and governance reporting

• Be a constant learner, active listener, and teacher to advance data science, people analytics, and Airbnb

• Use AI fluently - including the team's AirPanda platform and LLM-based agents - to accelerate analysis, prototyping, and synthesis, and to extend what a single researcher can deliver

Your Expertise:

• 5+ years in industry experience and a Master's degree/PhD in a quantitative field

• Deep experience with causal inference on observational data and quasi-experimental research design and analysis

• Proficiency in R or Python for statistical analysis, and SQL for data access

• Familiarity with survey design and analysis, as one of several methods in the toolkit

title: Content Strategist
description:

We're looking for a Content Strategist who doesn't just create; they lead. Someone who sees the whole board: brand voice, channel performance, customer journey, and creative quality all at once. If you've always wanted to own a content function that actually moves business outcomes for real, recognizable brands, this role was built for you.
Why you’ll love it here:

• 🔥 High autonomy, high trust: We hire smart people and give them ownership. No micromanagement, no endless approvals, no corporate bureaucracy. You’ll have the freedom to test ideas, move fast, and turn insights into high-performing content.

• 📈 Performance-driven creativity: We care about storytelling, but we care just as much about engagement, conversions, and business impact. You’ll use performance data to guide decisions, optimize content, and scale what works.

• 🤝 Collaborative creative environment: You’ll work closely with designers, Client Success Managers, and Performance Specialists in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment where ideas are valued, and initiative is rewarded.

• 🏡 Remote-first + flexible PTO: We care about outcomes, not clock-ins.

✨Who you are & the impact you’ll make:

• You think in strategy, not just tactics. You don’t ask “what should I post today?” - you ask “what does this brand need to achieve this quarter, and how does content help get us there?” You understand B2C buying psychology and how to move audiences from scroll to table.

• You know how to turn content into measurable growth. You lead content strategy across social media, email marketing, paid advertising, and websites, ensuring every touchpoint aligns with brand positioning, audience behaviour, and business goals.

• You own content calendars from planning through execution, develop creative briefs and messaging frameworks, and help guide content production through clear creative direction and shot lists.

• You write with intention. Your copy is clear, on-brand, and built to perform whether it’s a 3-word CTA for a Meta ad or a full email nurture sequence. You understand that tone is a strategy.

• You stay ahead of trends, platform behaviour, and cultural moments to create social strategies that feel relevant, engaging, and native to each platform.

• You know how to identify winning ideas and scale them. You use audience insights, performance data, and platform learnings to continuously optimize content across channels and formats.

• You own quality. Every piece of content that goes out under your watch reflects your standards. You review, refine, and push for better because you genuinely care about the work.

• You thrive in fast-moving, high-trust environments. We don’t micromanage. We set the direction, give you the tools, and trust you to execute.

This job is for you if:

• 💼 3+ years in digital marketing with a strong content strategy focus.

• 📱 Proven experience creating content across social media, email, and paid ads.

• ✍️ Strong copywriting skills across social, email, ads, and short-form content.

• 📅 Experience managing content calendars and overseeing creative quality.

• 🤝 Comfortable working cross-functionally in fast-paced environments.

• 🤖 Daily user of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini - you use them, not fear them).

• 🗣️ Fluent English (C1+).

Bonus Points For:

• Experience with restaurant, food & beverage, or hospitality brands.

• Monitor the competitive and regulatory landscape, including new guidance documents and enforcement actions, to proactively update internal policies and advise senior leadership on risk mitigation.

• Oversee vendors and manage budgets and resources.

Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems - fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking - for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.

At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.

Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Summary
In certain cases, Rivet partners with contract manufacturing (CM) and joint development manufacturing (JDM) partners to rapidly prototype, build, and scale our products. As a Global Supply Chain Manager (SCM), you'll own those partner relationships and make sure they deliver on Rivet's goals for cost, speed, quality, and compliance. You'll guide products from early builds (Proto, EVT, DVT, PVT) into production. You're a natural leader and facilitator who is driven, organized, and detail-oriented, keeps programs on schedule, and gets results through strong relationships.

Responsibilities:

- Lead the development and execution of long-term manufacturing partner strategies across CM and JDM partners

- Serve as the primary supply chain owner for manufacturing partners from NPI through Proto, EVT, DVT, PVT, and mass production

- Lead CM/JDM partner selection, qualification, onboarding, and transitions, including RFQs and partner capability assessments

- Drive build readiness with partners, including Clear-to-Build, material availability, line capacity, and build schedules

- Negotiate and manage CM/JDM pricing, including assembly and test costs, labor rates, overhead, yields, and markup on materials

- Develop and maintain should-cost models for manufacturing and conversion costs

- Plan and deliver on capacity planning for ramp and mass production, including line, test, and tooling capacity

- Manage partner-held inventory, liability, and excess and obsolescence exposure

- Drive quarterly business reviews with manufacturing partners, using scorecards for cost, quality, delivery, and responsiveness

- Negotiate Manufacturing Services Agreements, JDM agreements, and related contracts to align with Rivet’s business model and objectives

- Implement strategies to drive supply chain flexibility and risk mitigation, including dual-sourcing and regional manufacturing options

- Work with partners and internal Engineering, Quality, and Operations teams to resolve shortages, yield, and quality issues affecting production schedules

- Ensure manufacturing partners meet Rivet’s compliance requirements, including country-of-origin and government contract requirements

- Build effective relationships both internally and externally and interface with executive-level management at partners

- Support manufacturing partner initiatives, including annual cost reductions, VMI/JIT, lead-time reductions, and favorable payment terms

Required Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, or Supply Chain Management

- 7+ years of experience as a GSM/GCM or CM program manager in a fast-paced consumer electronics or hardware
